cross_object_findings.finding: A GitHub review object can be only an envelope identifying reviewed commit and review event. The substantive technical finding must be traced to inline comments or an explicit review body; the submission event alone does not qualify code.
Even boilerplate review submissions are useful to establish which commit was the review subject, preventing later findings from being silently transferred to a newer head.
An empty review body is an event, not evidence of approval, rejection or technical correctness.
